public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
    if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
    }

    String[] lines = mapText.split("\\r?\\n");
    if (lines.length < 2) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
    }

    // Parse undo limit from the first line
    int undoLimit;
    try {
        undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit format");
    }

    if (undoLimit < -1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
    }

    List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
    int height = mapLines.size();
    int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);

    Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
    Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Position, Box> boxesPositions = new HashMap<>();
    Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
    List<Box> boxesList = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Player> playersList = new ArrayList<>();

    // First pass: identify entities and validate
    for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
        String line = mapLines.get(y);
        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
            char ch = x < line.length() ? line.charAt(x) : ' '; // handle shorter lines
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            switch (ch) {
                case '#':
                    // Wall
                    // Will add later
                    break;
                case '@':
                    // Destination
                    destinations.add(pos);
                    break;
                case '.':
                    // Empty, do nothing
                    break;
                default:
                    if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
                        // Player
                        if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
                        }
                        playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
                        playersList.add(new Player(pos, ch - 'A' + 1)); // assuming Player constructor with id
                        playerIds.add(ch);
                    } else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
                        // Box
                        char upper = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
                        Box box = new Box(pos, upper - 'A' + 1);
                        boxesPositions.put(pos, box);
                        boxesList.add(box);
                    } else if (ch == ' '){
                        // Empty space, do nothing
                    } else {
                        // Could be Wall or invalid character
                        // Walls are handled separately, so ignore here
                    }
                    break;
            }
        }
    }

    // Validation: ensure at least one player
    if (playersPositions.isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
    }

    // Validate boxes and destinations count
    long boxCount = boxesPositions.size();
    long destinationCount = destinations.size();
    if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
    }

    // Validate boxes' player IDs
    for (Box box : boxesList) {
        int playerId = box.getPlayerId();
        if (!playerIds.contains((char) ('A' + playerId - 1))) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Box's player ID does not match any player on the board");
        }
    }

    // Validate players have corresponding boxes
    Set<Integer> playersWithBoxes = boxesList.stream()
            .map(Box::getPlayerId)
            .collect(Collectors.toSet());
    for (Player player : playersList) {
        if (!playersWithBoxes.contains(player.getId())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player " + player.getId() + " has no corresponding boxes");
        }
    }

    // Build the Entity map
    Map<Position, Entity> entityMap = new HashMap<>();
    // Add walls
    for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
        String line = mapLines.get(y);
        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
            char ch = x < line.length() ? line.charAt(x) : ' ';
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            if (ch == '#') {
                entityMap.put(pos, new Wall());
            }
        }
    }
    // Add destinations
    for (Position destPos : destinations) {
        entityMap.put(destPos, new Player(destPos, 0)); // placeholder, or a specific Destination entity if exists
        // But since destinations are special, perhaps store separately; for now, keep as set
    }
    // Add boxes

        entityMap.put(box.getPosition(), box);
    }
    // Add players

        entityMap.put(player.getPosition(), player);

    // Put entities into the map
```java
    for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entityMap.entrySet()) {
        gameMap.putEntity(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
    }

    return gameMap;
```

```java
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>

	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.

	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();

		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);

		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\r?\\n");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit format");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
		int height = mapLines.size();
		int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Position, Box> boxesPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		List<Box> boxesList = new ArrayList<>();
		List<Player> playersList = new ArrayList<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char ch = x < line.length() ? line.charAt(x) : ' ';
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
				case '#':
					break;
				case '@':
					destinations.add(pos);
					break;
				case '.':
					break;
				default:
					if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
						if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
						}
						playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
						playersList.add(new Player(pos, ch - 'A' + 1));
						playerIds.add(ch);
					} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
						char upper = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
						Box box = new Box(pos, upper - 'A' + 1);
						boxesPositions.put(pos, box);
						boxesList.add(box);
					} else if (ch == ' ') {
					} else {
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}
		if (playersPositions.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		long boxCount = boxesPositions.size();
		long destinationCount = destinations.size();
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
		}
		for (Box box : boxesList) {
			int playerId = box.getPlayerId();
			if (!playerIds.contains((char) ('A' + playerId - 1))) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Box's player ID does not match any player on the board");
			}
		}
		Set<Integer> playersWithBoxes = boxesList.stream().map(Box::getPlayerId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
		for (Player player : playersList) {
			if (!playersWithBoxes.contains(player.getId())) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player " + player.getId() + " has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		Map<Position, Entity> entityMap = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char ch = x < line.length() ? line.charAt(x) : ' ';
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				if (ch == '#') {
					entityMap.put(pos, new Wall());
				}
			}
		}
		for (Position destPos : destinations) {
			entityMap.put(destPos, new Player(destPos, 0));
		}
		for (Box box : boxesList) {
			entityMap.put(box.getPosition(), box);
		}
		for (Player player : playersList) {
			entityMap.put(player.getPosition(), player);
		}
		GameMap gameMap = new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entityMap.entrySet()) {
			gameMap.putEntity(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
		}
		return gameMap;
```
```java
	}
}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {

			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\r?\\n");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit format");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
		int height = mapLines.size();
		int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Position, Box> boxesPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		List<Box> boxesList = new ArrayList<>();
		List<Player> playersList = new ArrayList<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char ch = x < line.length() ? line.charAt(x) : ' ';
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
				case '#':
					break;
				case '@':
					destinations.add(pos);
					break;
				case '.':
					break;
				default:
					if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
						if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
						}
						playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
						playersList.add(new Player(pos, ch - 'A' + 1));
						playerIds.add(ch);
					} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
						char upper = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
						Box box = new Box(pos, upper - 'A' + 1);
						boxesPositions.put(pos, box);
						boxesList.add(box);
					} else if (ch == ' ') {
					} else {
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}
		if (playersPositions.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		long boxCount = boxesPositions.size();
		long destinationCount = destinations.size();
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
		}
		for (Box box : boxesList) {
			int playerId = box.getPlayerId();
			if (!playerIds.contains((char) ('A' + playerId - 1))) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Box's player ID does not match any player on the board");
			}
		}
		Set<Integer> playersWithBoxes = boxesList.stream().map(Box::getPlayerId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
		for (Player player : playersList) {
			if (!playersWithBoxes.contains(player.getId())) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player " + player.getId() + " has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		Map<Position, Entity> entityMap = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char ch = x < line.length() ? line.charAt(x) : ' ';
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				if (ch == '#') {
					entityMap.put(pos, new Wall());
				}
			}
		}
		for (Position destPos : destinations) {
			entityMap.put(destPos, new Player(destPos, 0));
		}
		for (Box box : boxesList) {
			entityMap.put(box.getPosition(), box);
		}
		for (Player player : playersList) {
			entityMap.put(player.getPosition(), player);
		}
		GameMap gameMap = new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entityMap.entrySet()) {
			gameMap.putEntity(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
		}
		return gameMap;
```

The method `getPlayerIds()` aims to return a set of unique player IDs present on the game map. Since players are represented by `Player` entities stored in the `map` field, we can filter the entities to find instances of `Player` and collect their IDs into a set.

Here's the complete implementation:

```java
public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
    return map.values().stream()
            .filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player)
            .map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
            .collect(Collectors.toSet());
}
```

**Explanation:**
- `map.values()` retrieves all entities on the map.
- `.filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player)` filters only `Player` instances.
- `.map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())` extracts the player ID.
- `.collect(Collectors.toSet())` gathers all IDs into a `Set<Integer>` to ensure uniqueness.

This implementation ensures that all player IDs currently present on the game map are returned as a set.

```java
package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

/**
 * A Sokoban game board.
 * GameBoard consists of information loaded from map data, such as
 * <li>Width and height of the game map</li>
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>
 * <li>Initial locations of boxes and player</li>
 * <p/>
 * GameBoard is capable to create many GameState instances, each representing an ongoing game.
 */
public class GameMap {

	private final Map<Position, Entity> map;

	private final int maxWidth;

	private final int maxHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private final int undoLimit;

	/**
	 * Create a new GameMap with width, height, set of box destinations and undo limit.
	 *
	 * @param maxWidth     Width of the game map.
	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMaxWidth() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\r?\\n");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit format");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
		int height = mapLines.size();
		int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Position, Box> boxesPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		List<Box> boxesList = new ArrayList<>();
		List<Player> playersList = new ArrayList<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char ch = x < line.length() ? line.charAt(x) : ' ';
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
				case '#':
					break;
				case '@':
					destinations.add(pos);
					break;
				case '.':
					break;
				default:
					if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
						if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
						}
						playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
						playersList.add(new Player(pos, ch - 'A' + 1));
						playerIds.add(ch);
					} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
						char upper = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
						Box box = new Box(pos, upper - 'A' + 1);
						boxesPositions.put(pos, box);
						boxesList.add(box);
					} else if (ch == ' ') {
					} else {
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}
		if (playersPositions.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		long boxCount = boxesPositions.size();
		long destinationCount = destinations.size();
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
		}
		for (Box box : boxesList) {
			int playerId = box.getPlayerId();
			if (!playerIds.contains((char) ('A' + playerId - 1))) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Box's player ID does not match any player on the board");
			}
		}
		Set<Integer> playersWithBoxes = boxesList.stream().map(Box::getPlayerId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
		for (Player player : playersList) {
			if (!playersWithBoxes.contains(player.getId())) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player " + player.getId() + " has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		Map<Position, Entity> entityMap = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char ch = x < line.length() ? line.charAt(x) : ' ';
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				if (ch == '#') {
					entityMap.put(pos, new Wall());
				}
			}
		}
		for (Position destPos : destinations) {
			entityMap.put(destPos, new Player(destPos, 0));
		}
		for (Box box : boxesList) {
			entityMap.put(box.getPosition(), box);
		}
		for (Player player : playersList) {
			entityMap.put(player.getPosition(), player);
		}
		GameMap gameMap = new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entityMap.entrySet()) {
			gameMap.putEntity(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
		}
		return gameMap;
	}

	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.get(position);
	}

	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		map.put(position, entity);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
		return undoLimit == -1 ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of(undoLimit);
	}
```

	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
```java
		return map.values().stream().filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player).map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}
}
```

```java
package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import assignment.entities.Wall;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * A Sokoban game board.
 * GameBoard consists of information loaded from map data, such as
 * <li>Width and height of the game map</li>
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>
 * <li>Initial locations of boxes and player</li>
 * <p/>
 * GameBoard is capable to create many GameState instances, each representing an ongoing game.
 */
public class GameMap {

	private final Map<Position, Entity> map;

	private final int maxWidth;

	private final int maxHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private final int undoLimit;

	/**
	 * Create a new GameMap with width, height, set of box destinations and undo limit.
	 *
	 * @param maxWidth     Width of the game map.
	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\r?\\n");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit format");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
		int height = mapLines.size();
		int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Position, Box> boxesPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		List<Box> boxesList = new ArrayList<>();
		List<Player> playersList = new ArrayList<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char ch = x < line.length() ? line.charAt(x) : ' ';
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
				case '#':
					break;
				case '@':
					destinations.add(pos);
					break;
				case '.':
					break;
				default:
					if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
						if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
						}
						playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
						playersList.add(new Player(pos, ch - 'A' + 1));
						playerIds.add(ch);
					} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
						char upper = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
						Box box = new Box(pos, upper - 'A' + 1);
						boxesPositions.put(pos, box);
						boxesList.add(box);
					} else if (ch == ' ') {
					} else {
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}
		if (playersPositions.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		long boxCount = boxesPositions.size();
		long destinationCount = destinations.size();
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
		}
		for (Box box : boxesList) {
			int playerId = box.getPlayerId();
			if (!playerIds.contains((char) ('A' + playerId - 1))) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Box's player ID does not match any player on the board");
			}
		}
		Set<Integer> playersWithBoxes = boxesList.stream().map(Box::getPlayerId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
		for (Player player : playersList) {
			if (!playersWithBoxes.contains(player.getId())) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player " + player.getId() + " has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		Map<Position, Entity> entityMap = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char ch = x < line.length() ? line.charAt(x) : ' ';
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				if (ch == '#') {
					entityMap.put(pos, new Wall());
				}
			}
		}
		for (Position destPos : destinations) {
			entityMap.put(destPos, new Player(destPos, 0));
		}
		for (Box box : boxesList) {
			entityMap.put(box.getPosition(), box);
		}
		for (Player player : playersList) {
			entityMap.put(player.getPosition(), player);
		}
		GameMap gameMap = new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entityMap.entrySet()) {
			gameMap.putEntity(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
		}
		return gameMap;
	}

	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.get(position);
	}

	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		map.put(position, entity);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
		return undoLimit == -1 ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of(undoLimit);
	}

	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
		return map.values().stream().filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player).map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	public int getMaxWidth() {
		return maxWidth;
	}
}
```

The method `fetchAction()` should read user input, interpret it, and return the corresponding `Action` object. Typically, commands like "exit", "undo", or movement keys ("WASD" etc.) are mapped to specific actions. If the input doesn't match any known command, an `InvalidInput` action should be returned.

Here's a complete implementation:

```java
@Override
public Action fetchAction() {
    final String inputLine = terminalScanner.nextLine().trim();

    // Check for exit command
    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase(EXIT_COMMAND_TEXT)) {
        return new Exit();
    }

    // Check for undo command
    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase("U") || inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase("Undo")) {
        return new Undo();
    }

    // Check for move commands
    Matcher matcher = MOVE_REGEX.matcher(inputLine);
    if (matcher.matches()) {
        String actionChar = matcher.group("action").toUpperCase();
        switch (actionChar) {
            case "W":
                return new Move(Move.Direction.UP);
            case "A":
                return new Move(Move.Direction.LEFT);
            case "S":
                return new Move(Move.Direction.DOWN);
            case "D":
                return new Move(Move.Direction.RIGHT);
            case "R":
                return new Move(Move.Direction.RESTART);
            case "H":
                return new Move(Move.Direction.HELP);
            case "J":
                return new Move(Move.Direction.JUMP);
            case "K":
                return new Move(Move.Direction.KICK);
            case "L":
                return new Move(Move.Direction.LOOK);
            default:
                return new InvalidInput(INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE);
        }
    }

    // If input doesn't match any command, return InvalidInput
    return new InvalidInput(INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE);
}
```

- Reads a line from the user.
- Checks for specific commands like exit or undo.
- Uses regex to match movement or action commands.
- Returns the appropriate `Action` object based on input.
- Defaults to `InvalidInput` if no command matches.

This implementation ensures the method handles various user inputs gracefully and integrates seamlessly with the existing command pattern.

Response Text:---
The errors indicate that:
- The constructors for `Exit` and `Undo` require an `int` argument, likely an error code or similar.
- The `Move` class is abstract and cannot be instantiated directly; instead, you should use a concrete subclass or a factory method.
- The `InvalidInput` constructor requires two arguments: an `int` and a `String`.

Assuming the constructors require an error code (e.g., 0) and the `Move` class has specific subclasses for each direction (e.g., `MoveUp`, `MoveDown`, etc.), the corrected method should instantiate these concrete classes accordingly.

Here's the corrected method:

```java
@Override
public Action fetchAction() {
    final String inputLine = terminalScanner.nextLine().trim();

    // Check for exit command
    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase(EXIT_COMMAND_TEXT)) {
        return new Exit(0);
    }

    // Check for undo command
    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase("U") || inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase("Undo")) {
        return new Undo(0);
    }

    // Check for move commands
    Matcher matcher = MOVE_REGEX.matcher(inputLine);
    if (matcher.matches()) {
        String actionChar = matcher.group("action").toUpperCase();
        switch (actionChar) {
            case "W":
                return new MoveUp(0);
            case "A":
                return new MoveLeft(0);
            case "S":
                return new MoveDown(0);
            case "D":
                return new MoveRight(0);
            case "R":
                return new Restart(0);
            case "H":
                return new Help(0);
            case "J":
                return new Jump(0);
            case "K":
                return new Kick(0);
            case "L":
                return new Look(0);
            default:
                return new InvalidInput(0, INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE);
        }
    }

    // If input doesn't match any command, return InvalidInput
    return new InvalidInput(0, INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE);
}
```

**Note:** This assumes that each action (e.g., `MoveUp`, `MoveLeft`, `Restart`, `Help`, `Jump`, `Kick`, `Look`) is a concrete subclass of `Action` with a constructor accepting an `int` error code. If the actual classes differ, adjust accordingly.

```java
package assignment.tui;

import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import assignment.entities.Wall;
import assignment.game.GameState;
import assignment.game.Position;
import assignment.game.RenderingEngine;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.io.PrintStream;

/**
 * A rendering engine that prints to the terminal.
 */
public class TerminalRenderingEngine implements RenderingEngine {

	private final PrintStream outputStream;

	/**
	 * @param outputStream The {@link PrintStream} to write the output to.
	 */
	public TerminalRenderingEngine(PrintStream outputStream) {
		this.outputStream = outputStream;
	}

	@Override
	public void render(@NotNull GameState state) {
		final StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
		for (int y = 0; y < state.getMapMaxHeight(); y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < state.getMapMaxWidth(); x++) {
				final Entity entity = state.getEntity(Position.of(x, y));
				char charToPrint = ' ';
				if (entity instanceof Wall) {
					charToPrint = '#';
				}
				if (entity instanceof Box box) {
					charToPrint = (char) (box.getPlayerId() + 'a');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Player player) {
					charToPrint = (char) (player.getId() + 'A');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Empty) {
					charToPrint = state.getDestinations().contains(new Position(x, y)) ? '@' : '.';
				}
				builder.append(charToPrint);
			}
			builder.append('\n');
		}
		outputStream.print(builder);
	}

	@Override
	public void message(String content) {
		// TODO
		// Hint: System.out is also a PrintStream.
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}
}
```

```java
package assignment.tui;

import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import assignment.entities.Wall;
import assignment.game.GameState;
import assignment.game.Position;
import assignment.game.RenderingEngine;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.io.PrintStream;

/**
 * A rendering engine that prints to the terminal.
 */
public class TerminalRenderingEngine implements RenderingEngine {

	private final PrintStream outputStream;

	/**
	 * @param outputStream The {@link PrintStream} to write the output to.
	 */
	public TerminalRenderingEngine(PrintStream outputStream) {
		this.outputStream = outputStream;
	}

	@Override
	public void render(@NotNull GameState state) {
		final StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
		for (int y = 0; y < state.getMapMaxHeight(); y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < state.getMapMaxWidth(); x++) {
				final Entity entity = state.getEntity(Position.of(x, y));
				char charToPrint = ' ';
				if (entity instanceof Wall) {
					charToPrint = '#';
				}
				if (entity instanceof Box box) {
					charToPrint = (char) (box.getPlayerId() + 'a');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Player player) {
					charToPrint = (char) (player.getId() + 'A');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Empty) {
					charToPrint = state.getDestinations().contains(new Position(x, y)) ? '@' : '.';
				}
				builder.append(charToPrint);
			}
			builder.append('\n');
		}
		outputStream.print(builder);
	}

	@Override
	public void message(String content) {
		// TODO
		// Hint: System.out is also a PrintStream.
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}
}
```

Response Text:---
The `run()` method should implement the main game loop for the terminal Sokoban game. Typically, this involves rendering the current game state, processing user input, executing actions based on input, updating the game state, and repeating until the game ends. 

Here's a complete implementation of the `run()` method that performs these steps:

```java
@Override
public void run() {
    boolean gameRunning = true;
    while (gameRunning) {
        // Render the current game state
        renderingEngine.render(getGameState());

        // Get user input
        String input = inputEngine.readInput();

        // Process input into an action
        Action action = parseInputToAction(input);

        // Execute the action
        ActionResult result = executeAction(action);

        // Check if the game has ended
        if (result.isGameOver()) {
            gameRunning = false;
            renderingEngine.renderGameOver(result);
        }
    }
}
```

Note: This implementation assumes the existence of methods like `parseInputToAction(String)` and `executeAction(Action)` within the class, as well as the `renderingEngine.renderGameOver()` method. You may need to implement or adapt these methods accordingly.

```java
        // Render the current game state
        renderingEngine.render(getGameState());

        // Get user input
        String input = inputEngine.readInput();

        // Process input into an action
        Action action = parseInputToAction(input);

        // Execute the action
        ActionResult result = executeAction(action);

        // Check if the game has ended
        if (result.isGameOver()) {
            gameRunning = false;
            renderingEngine.renderGameOver(result);
        }
    }
}
```

**Note:**  
- Make sure `getGameState()` is a method in `AbstractSokobanGame` or replace it with direct access to the `gameState` field if accessible.  
- Implement `parseInputToAction()` and `executeAction()` methods within your class.  
- Confirm that `renderGameOver()` exists in `RenderingEngine`.
